scope: Internal UI reference contract; not IPC, host state or a new plug-in parameter schema.

implementations.vst3: Future native adapter to Processor, Broker and Probeeq

invariants: Preview and draft never create a confirmed revision.
Sending a draft from Overview never changes confirmed EQ state.
The first EQ Apply starts a ten-second temporary lease; only confirmation creates a revision.
Reject, lease expiry, transport invalidation or connection loss return to the confirmed curve.
Recording or unknown record state blocks preview visibly.
Protected ranges are hard limits for Nakama pointer, keyboard and numeric input.
External host automation may cross a protected range and must mark the violation visibly.
External automation makes any open draft stale.
Undo is scoped to the selected source and confirmed revisions only.
Master is separate from the source switcher and source wheel order.
Both Gen surfaces keep a fixed 76:43 aspect ratio with 760x430 as compact minimum and 950x538 as default.
Window resizing grows the graph or acoustic evidence first; UI scale remains independent.
All functions available at the default Gen size remain reachable at the compact minimum.
Mix remains planned until a versioned parameter contract exists.
Every visible non-identity element is either an operating control or an honest state/value.
